func_info.tip: a 用在辅音音素开头的词前（a book, a uniform），an 用在元音音素开头的词前（an apple, an hour）：看读音，不看字母。

senses.ex_en: I have an apple and a banana.
senses.ex_zh: 我有一个苹果和一根香蕉。

heavy.example_zh: 我有一个苹果和一根香蕉。
heavy.example_en: I have an apple and a banana.

func_info.tip: 特指说话双方都知道的人或物：Open the door. 在元音音素前常读 /ði/（the apple）。

light.meaning: 是（原形 be；现在时 am / is / are）

func_info.tip: I 配 am，he / she / it 和单数配 is，you 和复数配 are；原形 be 用在 will、can 等后面：I will be ten.

senses.ex_en: I am a student. She is my sister.

heavy.example_en: I am a student. She is my sister.

func_info.tip: 后面跟动词原形：I can swim. 否定 can't / cannot；问句把 can 提到句首：Can you swim?

senses.ex_en: I can swim. Can you swim?

heavy.example_en: I can swim. Can you swim?

func_info.tip: will + 动词原形表示将来：It will rain tomorrow. 否定 won't = will not。
must + 动词原形表示必须；mustn't 表示禁止（不许）。

senses.ex_en: You must wash your hands before dinner.

heavy.example_en: You must wash your hands before dinner.

func_info.tip: should + 动词原形表示建议、应该做的事：You should drink more water.

senses.ex_en: You should go to bed early.

heavy.example_en: You should go to bed early.

func_info.tip: 放在 be 动词、情态动词或助动词后面构成否定：I am not tired. He does not like milk. 缩写 isn't、can't、don't。

senses.ex_en: Is this your pen? No, it isn't.
senses.ex_zh: 这是你的钢笔吗？不，不是。

senses.ex_en: There is no milk in the cup.

heavy.example_zh: 这是你的钢笔吗？不，不是。
heavy.example_en: Is this your pen? No, it isn't.

senses.ex_en: Are you ready? Yes, I am.

heavy.example_en: Are you ready? Yes, I am.

heavy.syntax_contrast: please 可以放句首或句尾：Please help me. / Help me, please.（放句尾时前面加逗号）

senses.ex_en: Let's go to the park. OK!

heavy.example_en: Let's go to the park. OK!

heavy.syntax_contrast: 比较级 better，最高级 best（不规则）。good 是形容词，修饰名词；修饰动作用 well：He sings well.
比较级 worse，最高级 worst（不规则）。

senses.ex_en: The Great Wall is in China.
What's your name? My name is Tom.
senses.ex_zh: 你叫什么名字？我叫汤姆。

heavy.example_zh: 你叫什么名字？我叫汤姆。
heavy.example_en: What's your name? My name is Tom.

heavy.syntax_contrast: 问年龄说 How old are you?，回答 I'm ten (years old).
不可数名词：前面用 much / some，不用 a 或 many；问多少钱说 How much money?

senses.ex_en: My mother is very busy today.

heavy.example_en: My mother is very busy today.

senses.ex_en: I get up early every day.

heavy.example_en: I get up early every day.

senses.ex_en: The little cat is so cute.

heavy.example_en: The little cat is so cute.

heavy.syntax_contrast: 过去式 sat（不规则）；现在分词双写 t：sitting。
let + 人 + 动词原形：Let me help you. Let's = Let us。过去式还是 let。

senses.ex_en: Hurry up! The bus is coming.

heavy.example_en: Hurry up! The bus is coming.

light.spelling_alert: ⚠️ wr 开头的 w 不发音

senses.ex_en: Can I use your pen? Sure.
senses.ex_zh: 我能用你的钢笔吗？当然。

heavy.example_zh: 我能用你的钢笔吗？当然。
heavy.example_en: Can I use your pen? Sure.

senses.ex_en: The bank is next to the park.
The bird is at the top of the tree.

heavy.example_en: The bird is at the top of the tree.

senses.ex_en: There is a tree in front of my house.

heavy.syntax_contrast: in front of 在……（外部的）前面；in the front of 在……（内部的）前部：in the front of the bus。
heavy.example_en: There is a tree in front of my house.

heavy.syntax_contrast: 常和现在进行时连用：I am reading now.

senses.ex_en: I saw him two days ago.

heavy.syntax_contrast: 放在时间段后面：two days ago；句子用一般过去时。
heavy.example_en: I saw him two days ago.

senses.ex_en: I went to Beijing last summer.

heavy.example_en: I went to Beijing last summer.

heavy.syntax_contrast: good 修饰名词（a good singer），well 修饰动作（sings well）；比较级 better，最高级 best。

light.meaning: 许多（a lot / a lot of）

senses.ex_en: There are a lot of books in the library.

heavy.syntax_contrast: a lot of 后面可接可数名词复数，也可接不可数名词：a lot of apples, a lot of water。
heavy.example_en: There are a lot of books in the library.

heavy.syntax_contrast: 写信开头：Dear + 名字，后面用逗号。

senses.ex_en: There are ten candles on the cake.

heavy.example_en: There are ten candles on the cake.

senses.ex_en: I do some chores at home every day.
senses.ex_zh: 我每天在家做一些家务。

heavy.example_zh: 我每天在家做一些家务。
heavy.example_en: I do some chores at home every day.

senses.ex_en: I write an email to my friend.
senses.ex_zh: 我给朋友写一封电子邮件。

heavy.example_zh: 我给朋友写一封电子邮件。
heavy.example_en: I write an email to my friend.

heavy.syntax_contrast: TV 是 television 的缩写；watch TV 不加 the。

senses.ex_zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。

heavy.syntax_contrast: favourite 本身就是“最”喜欢，前面不再加 most。
heavy.example_zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。

senses.ex_en: Mr Li is our English teacher.
senses.ex_zh: 李先生是我们的英语老师。

heavy.syntax_contrast: Mr / Mrs / Ms / Miss 后面接姓：Mr Li；英式不加点，美式写 Mr.
heavy.example_zh: 李先生是我们的英语老师。
heavy.example_en: Mr Li is our English teacher.

light.meaning: 女士（对女子的通用称呼）
小姐；（学生称呼女老师）老师

senses.ex_en: The police are helping the old man.

heavy.syntax_contrast: the police 作主语时动词用复数 are；一名警察说 a police officer。
heavy.example_en: The police are helping the old man.

heavy.syntax_contrast: 国名首字母大写；小写 china 是“瓷器”。

senses.ex_en: There is cream on the cake.

heavy.example_en: There is cream on the cake.
